title: slopvac v3 style preset
description: An ordered preset of category and rule levels and of terms. A config lists styles in order and the last one wins. A style may extend other styles, which apply first. A style declares the styles it cannot combine with, and the host reports a conflict when both are active. Semantics are specified in docs/contract/packs.md. Owner: slopvac-8l4.2.4.

extends.description: Styles applied before this one, lowest first.

conflicts.description: Styles that must not be active together with this one.

categories.description: Category levels, keyed by category name.

rules.description: Rule levels, keyed by rule name. A rule entry wins over the category entry.

Ref.description: A style name: bare when unambiguous across the active packs, or <pack>:<name>.

Key.description: A rule or category name: qualified <pack>:<id> or a bare name. Same shape as RuleKey in config.schema.json.

Level.description: The level a rule or category reports at. off disables it.

files.description: Terms files, relative to this style file.
